dasha_principles: The planet gives prominent results according to its strength, the house it occupies, houses it aspects, houses it rules, and its natural karakatwa during its dasha.
Planets in Sheershodya signs (3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 11) give results at the beginning of dasha; Prishtodya signs (1, 2, 4, 9, 10) at the end; Ubhayodaya (12th) throughout.
Retrograde planets reverse the early/middle/late delivery sequence (Parashar dreshkana rule).
Mixed auspicious and inauspicious causes produce mixed dasha results; whichever side is stronger dominates.
When the Sun transits the sign of the antardasha lord, that lord's results manifest clearly.
Coordinate gochar with the running dasha; transit alone does not override birth-chart strength.
